items.headline: Nicklaus Critiques PGA Schedule
items.text: Jack Nicklaus criticized the PGA Tour's current schedule for stacking too many big-money events in seven months, warning it strains players' rest and ability to peak for majors and meeting with Tour leaders to discuss the calendar's future.

items.headline: Rahm Rejects LIV Investor Role
items.text: Jon Rahm said he is not involved in LIV Golf's investor recruitment because he 'knows nothing about business,' prioritizing playing golf and family over pitching LIV's financial backers.
